name: D&D 5.5e Combat Engine
description: Tabletop d20 combat engine for D&D 5.5e. Resolves ability-score modifiers (CHA/INT/WIS/STR/DEX), AC, spell attack rolls, saving throw DCs, cantrip scaling, martial extra attacks, rogue sneak attack, and HP. Add as an Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Misc Agents for Roleplay and Game modes.
